questions.markdown: Illustrate the different types of optical fibres based on their refractive index profiles. Discuss the communication application of optical fiber with block diagram.

An atom has two energy levels with a transition wavelength of 582 nm. At 300 K, $4.0 \times 10^{20}$ atoms are in the lower state. (a) How many occupy the upper state under conditions of thermal equilibrium? (b) Suppose, instead, that $7.0 \times 10^{20}$ atoms are pumped into upper state, with $4.0 \times 10^{20}$ atoms in the lower state. How much energy could be released in a single laser pulse?
If a laser medium has a very short excited-state lifetime, how does it affect laser action? Justify your answer.

Analyze the relationship between the scattering angle and the wavelength shift when the target metal is exposed to extremely intense and monochromatic electromagnetic radiation and discuss the physical significance of the Compton effect.

In an experiment, the tungsten cathode which has a threshold of 435 nm is irradiated by ultraviolet light of wavelength 215 nm. Calculate (i) maximum energy of emitted photoelectrons, and (ii) work function for tungsten (in eV).

If the frequency of incident radiation is increased beyond the threshold while intensity is kept constant, what happens to:
(i) The number of emitted electrons, and
(ii) Their kinetic energy?
Solve the Schrodinger equation for a particle of mass $m$ in a one-dimensional infinite potential well (box) of length $L$ and obtain an expression for wavefunction of the particle.

A student conducted an experiment on the photoelectric effect by shining light with a wavelength of 500 nm onto a metal surface. To stop the flow of photocurrent, the student applied a negative potential until the current dropped to zero. He repeated the experiment by varying the distance of the light source (with no other changes made to the experimental setup). How do these variations in distance affect the stopping potential and photocurrent? Justify your answer.

Well-1 and Well-2 are two square wells having same length. Well-1 has walls of finite height, and well-2 has walls of infinite height. Both the wells contain identical quantum particles, one in each well. Compare the magnitude of the ground-state momentum.

Based on the obtained output, draw the equivalent two-qubit gate for the above quantum circuit.

questions.markdown: Explain Bloch sphere representation of a qubit.

Both the set of all complex column matrices of order $(n \times 1)$ and the set of all complex row matrices of order $(1 \times n)$ form linear vector spaces (LVS) over the field of complex numbers. State whether the given statement is True or False. Justify your answer.
Explain the postulates of Quantum Mechanics.
Show that the SWAP gate/circuit interchanges the state of the two qubits.

Given:

$$
|\psi\rangle = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}|0\rangle + \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}|1\rangle
$$

$$
|\psi'\rangle = \frac{i}{\sqrt{2}}|0\rangle + \frac{i}{\sqrt{2}}|1\rangle
$$

Are $|\psi\rangle$ and $|\psi'\rangle$ globally phase equivalent? Explain.
